model.name: Selecting a diagram element scrolls and expands the model tree to reveal that element (reuse R33.5 expandPath, selection-triggered)
model.description: Tron item-4. Selecting a diagram element -> the model/itemview TREE navigates/scrolls that element into view AND expands its ancestry as necessary to reveal the node. Reuse the R33.5 expandPath uuid-walk / revealNode (already built + gated) - here triggered by DIAGRAM-element SELECTION (tree-side reveal), NO re-fork.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (2026-07-31): selecting an element should make the tree navigate/scroll it into view and expand as necessary to reveal it.

discoverySource.note: Tron item-4: diagram-element selection -> tree scroll+expand reveal. Reuse R33.5 expandPath (built+gated), selection-triggered, NO re-fork.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Selecting a diagram element dispatches a tree-reveal for that element's uuid: the model tree scrolls it into view AND expands the ancestry (mof-m1 -> project -> file -> class) as needed so the node is VISIBLE + highlighted. Reuse R33.5 expandPath / revealNode (uuid-walk) - selection-triggered from the diagram, no new reveal mechanism.

GATE @390 (screenshot/pixel + planted bite): select an element in the diagram -> the tree scrolls + expands to its node (visible + highlighted); planted: selection changes but the tree does not reveal/expand to it = RED.

model.designAdopted: Adopted design 293b9cc43: AC-select-reveals-tree <- INV-TR1/2/3 (new RbTraceTree.onTreeReveal listener connects the dead boxSelect rb-tree-reveal dispatch -> reuse revealNode/expandPath, lazy-safe). 1 chain; reuse-no-fork.
